name: upwork-mcp-ui
description: Self-hosted freelancer-side Upwork UI built on the official Upwork MCP server

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
